prompt: Our charter brokerage has three new client trip requests sitting in `client_requests.csv` at the root of the workspace. The sales team used their own informal language to capture each client's sailing experience and interests, so the data is a bit rough. We need you to process all three requests and produce a single file called `charter_itineraries.json` containing complete BVI sailing itineraries for each one — including day-by-day anchorage plans, provisioning details scaled to the group size, and weather/routing notes. The three clients are the Harrington Family (7 days, 4 guests), the Whitfield Corporate Group (10 days, 8 guests), and the Chen Honeymoon couple (5 days, 2 guests). Please make sure each itinerary reflects the appropriate level of complexity for that group and captures what each client wants to do on the water.
